test_actions.text:
Move direction Selector to "V"
Maintain Master controller in COAST
Move master controller to Min propulsion
Move master controller to Max propulsion
Move master controller to Min propulsion
Move master controller to Min Brake

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Check Master Controller error generation
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Check Master Controller error generation

test_actions.text:
Fatal Error IO and analog signals:
Remove the wire 86140.54 from pin 41b of power strip XT14.113 in enabled cab (C1) OR wire 86140.54 from pin 51b of power strip XT14.113 in enabled cab (C2)

Lost of digital signals IO1
Remove the wire 16122.13 from pin 31b (C1) OR 34b (C2) of power strip XT14.113 in enabled cab.
Remove the wire 16122.12 from pin 31b (C1) OR 34b (C2) of power strip XT14.113 in enabled cab.
Move Master Controller to Propulsion area

Lost of digital signals IO2
Remove the wire 16122.14 from pin 32b of power strip XT14.113 in enabled cab (C1) OR wire 16122.07 from pin  33b of power strip XT14.113 in enabled cab (C2).
Move Master Controller to Brake area

Normalize the wires.
Move master controller in COAST area

Lost of Analog input 1
Remove the wire 86120.24 from pin 57a of power strip XT14.113 in enabled cab.
Move master controller to Max Brake

Test_Cases.description:

test_actions.text:

Lost of both analog inputs

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Verify to start vehicle it is necessary to press the deadman pushbutton in the handle before to reset the propulsion enable loop is reset.
During these Test vehicle can be moved. Pay attention to avoid the presence of any person in the vehicle exterior.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Verify to start vehicle it is necessary to press the deadman pushbutton in the handle before to reset the propulsion enable loop is reset.
During these Test vehicle can be moved. Pay attention to avoid the presence of any person in the vehicle exterior.
initial_conditions: -HV is connected to the vehicle and pantographs is up.

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton for Door Release to command close all the doors.
All Doors closed and indication will be displayed on HMI.
Move the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to Propulsion area

Return back PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to COAST.
Press deadman pedal and release it
Move back again the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to Propulsion area

Return back PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
Move back again the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to Propulsion area
Return back PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to COAST.

Open again the propulsion Enable Loop by 
moving PROPULSION/BRAKE Handle to Emergency Brake

Check if reset maneouver is not done the vehicle will not move:
Move the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to Propulsion area

Return back PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
Move back again the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to Propulsion area

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Verify opening of a door will open the propulsion loop is open. Each door interruption in the All Doors closed Loop is already tested in other procedure, in this procedure only single door will be checked.
During these Test vehicle can be moved. Pay attention to avoid the presence of any person in the vehicle exterior.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Verify opening of a door will open the propulsion loop is open. Each door interruption in the All Doors closed Loop is already tested in other procedure, in this procedure only single door will be checked.
During these Test vehicle can be moved. Pay attention to avoid the presence of any person in the vehicle exterior.
initial_conditions: -HV is connected to the vehicle and pantographs is up.
- Doors are closed and not released

test_actions.text:
PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
Move back again the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to Propulsion area

In Passenger Area:
- Open any door by using door emergency release switch.
Actuate All Doors Closed Bypass in the cab enabled

PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
Move back again the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to Propulsion area
Normalize All Doors Closed Bypass in the cab enabled
Actuate All Doors Closed Bypass in the cab not enabled

PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
Move back again the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to Propulsion area

Normalize All Doors Closed Bypass in the cab not enabled
And normalize the emergency opened door

PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
Move back again the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to Propulsion area

Test_Cases.name:

During these Test vehicle can be moved. Pay attention to avoid the presence of any person in the vehicle exterior.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Verify failure of the PZB, opens the propulsion loop. 
During these Test vehicle can be moved. Pay attention to avoid the presence of any person in the vehicle exterior.
initial_conditions: -HV is connected to the vehicle and pantographs is up.
- Doors are closed and not released

test_actions.text:
PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
Move back again the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to Propulsion area

In car C2, simulate a failure of PZB.
Disconnect cable 43351.01 form terminal bar 43XT01, terminal 70
wait for 3 seconds
In cab enabled used the PZB bypass

PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
Move back again the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to Propulsion area

In car C2,
Reconnect cable 43351.01 to terminal bar 43XT01, terminal 70
and reset PZB bypass switch

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Verify that if vehicle is not stopped and emergency Brake 1/2 is not applied, it is not possible to activate TCMS degraded mode and the propulsion loop is opened.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Verify that if vehicle is not stopped and emergency Brake 1/2 is not applied, it is not possible to activate TCMS degraded mode and the propulsion loop is opened.
initial_conditions: - Doors are closed and not released

test_actions.text:
PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
Check Relay 16K01 is not energized at any car

Left HMI inactive, is  showing TCMS degraded mode.
Right HMI is active but indicates TCMS degraded mode is active
Measure at terminal var XT14.113 terminal 24a: 0Vdc

PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in Emergency.
Simulate vehicle is not stopped.
Disconnect cable 18140.07 from terminal bar XT55.101 terminal 03
Check Relay 16K01 is not energized at any car

Left HMI inactive, is  showing TCMS degraded mode.
Right HMI is active but indicates TCMS degraded mode is active
Measure at terminal var XT14.113 terminal 24a: 0Vdc

Reset TCMS Degraded mode switch 16S01
Simulate vehicle is stopped.
Connect cable 18140.07 to terminal bar XT55.101 terminal 03

PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it

PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in Emergency.
vehicle is stopped
Activate TCMS Degraded mode switch 16S01
Check Relay 16K01 is energized at all car

Left HMI inactive, is  showing TCMS degraded mode.
Right HMI is active but indicates TCMS degraded mode is active
Measure at terminal var XT14.113 terminal 24a: 24Vdc
Check Relay 16K01 is denergized at all car
Measure at terminal var XT14.113 terminal 24a: 0Vdc

PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Verify that if vehicle isolation state of the brakes is unknown in all bogies the propulsion loop is opened.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Verify that if vehicle isolation state of the brakes is unknown in all bogies the propulsion loop is opened.
initial_conditions: - Doors are closed and not released

test_actions.text:
PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, select the virtual pushbutton for Motor Bogie C1.
- Operate Parking Brake Bypass Switch 32S06.
Motor Bogie Safety Brake is hydraulically released.
Operate the valve H14 to block the hydraulic circuirt of Motor Bogie C1
Wait for the presure to fall below 82 bar.

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, select the virtual pushbutton for Trailer Bogie.
Trailer Bogie Safety Brake is hydraulically released.
Operate the valve H14 to block the hydraulic circuirt of Trailer Bogie
Wait for the presure to fall below 82 bar.

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, select the virtual pushbutton for Motor Bogie C2.
Motor Bogie Safety Brake is hydraulically released.
Operate the valve H14 to block the hydraulic circuirt of Motor Bogie C2
Wait for the presure to fall below 82 bar.
Traction loop is opened in the vehicle
Move all H14 valves from the blocking position.
